profile.headline: Full-Stack Senior Engineer & Developer Lead
profile.summary:
My catchphrase is "How can I help?". My greatest skills are my ability to build relationships, communicate effectively, and support teams.

I have led teams for both React web and React Native mobile applications, delivering multi-platform, full-scale e-commerce and MARTECH solutions to support business and user needs. As an individual contributor my focus is on clean, reusable, and scalable code backed by thorough unit tests and best practices. A project's repo should sparkle! There's code that works, then there's code that shines. 

I have a bachelor's degree in Psychology and a background in leadership, team building, and management. I'm a proud badged graduated of the DevMountain Full-Stack web development program.

positions.title: React Native Dev Lead - Senior Engineer
positions.description:
Accepted a promotion to Senior Engineer and Developer Lead for our internal React Native iOS application. In this role, I set the direction and pace for development, assist in determining the team priorities alongside team business representatives, mentor and assist fellow devs in their day-to-day work, and represent the team in interdepartmental calls and communication.


Delivered a full e-commerce, outreach (MarTech), and metrics platform 
• Product Pages, Product Lists, Cart, Checkout and more
• In-store checkout via POS & online checkout both available in-app
• Employee, Manager, and Customer sales metrics dashboards
• App-wide systems for user generated custom content for outreach
• Full messaging & outreach services in-app (SMS, Email, Cross-App)
Owned mobile app CI/CD pipelines end-to-end (Bitrise, CircleCI, Firebase)
Custom built in-app notification system via GraphQL
Implemented auth via Cognito with Entra & Okta MFAs
Delivered an automated outreach system (MarTech)
• Published to more than 1 million recipients via AWS Lambdas, SQS & S3
• Achieved scalability by attaching SQS queue for asynchronous batch processing
Integrated Firebase Analytics & Quantum Metrics user session monitoring
• Used analytics data to aggressively target bugs & raised app stability to >99.9%
• Significantly reduced support team overhead & turnaround time
Owned app tech-debt initiatives end-to-end
• Created, groomed, managed & assigned stories and tasks for all tech-debt work
Supported the org through peak sale periods by ensuring scalability of critical services
Owned app UX-uplift project end-to-end to update and modernize app UX
• Worked directly with UX team to create new designs based on UI Team needs, user feedback, and analytics data
• Owned, groomed, and assigned all tickets

positions.title: React Native UI Lead - Engineer 2
positions.description: Transitioned to React Native development team as company pivots from previous SPA project. Maintained role as UI Lead for this new project. Spearheaded team efforts to refactor the project's codebase, bringing the application to industry standards. This effort included replacing and updating all packages to stable builds including updating the React Native framework version; completely re-tooling in-app navigation; updating state/data management paradigms across the app; adding support for industry standard tools including ESLint, Prettier, Typescript, React Redux, React Query, Snyk vulnerability detection; building custom re-usable components to enhance developer experience & app cohesion; refactoring user auth flow; and refactoring screens for performance & reliability across the app. Additionally established version control measures, participated in recruitment and hiring efforts by acting as primary UI interviewer, worked directly with UX team to enhance user experience, and supported QA team by establishing UI guidelines for accessibility parameters and test ID values.

positions.title: React UI Lead - Engineer 2
positions.description: Accepted a promotion to the position of Engineer 2 (skipping Engineer 1) with Neiman Marcus as well as the role of UI Lead for an internal React PWA project. In this role I lead efforts to completely overhaul the UI's unit tests and bring the codebase up to modern standards. We incorporated Typescript linting, updated ESLint rules, and adopted React Testing Library. Together, the team completely replaced all existing unit tests and raised application test coverage to over 95%. During this time we both updated and expanded our suite of communication tools. I worked with our product team to develop updated email templates based on a component architecture utilizing mustache syntax and HTML to solve limitations in our existing template designs that hampered product's ability to create unique and attractive email campaigns; an SMS-in-Browser solution opening the door for employee driven direct marketing to clients via SMS in addition to our e-mail capabilities; and a cross-app communication tool that allowed our users to communicate with clients via real-time chat on the customer facing app.

positions.title: Associate Engineer
positions.description: Accepted a Jr role with Neiman Marcus as a member of their internal React PWA project, an omni-tool for store employees and digital employees. In this role I assisted in developing store-level metrics dashboards and employee management tools for managers; sales catalogues, personal metrics dashboards, and full POS/Point of Sale capabilities & product catalog for store employees; and robust communication and marketing tools for digital employees such as full email capabilities with a suite of templates, products, and business-developed content to share with clients, and the tools to create their own custom content for sharing.

positions.title: Web Development Student
positions.description:
Web Development student studying full-stack development through Javascript and React. Completed three projects in-house:

	Ø NoDatabase: Nutrition Calculator
○ A calorie calculator featuring common sandwich ingredients from sandwich store chains allowing the end-user to calculate the nutritional content of a full meal from their favorite sandwich shop.
	Ø Personal: PetThatPet!
○ Social media service allowing users to upload pet photos and rate/"pet" other people's pets, utilizing AWS S3 for storage and AWS Rekognition to block harmful content and automatically categorize pets based on photo content. 
	Ø Group: Pounds Around Town
○ Connecting animal lovers and rescue services to put rescue animals in forever homes by providing a centralized, design-focused repository for rescue services and pounds to provide photos, details and adoption information to end users.

positions.title: General Manager
positions.description: Entered into the business as a delivery driver and took a General Manager position within nine months. Successfully lead four stores over a four year period while earning top inspection scores, recruiting and training three General Managers, and achieving sales and service growths in each location.

positions.title: Lead Mental Health Technician
positions.description: Adult population lead MHT responsible for safety and security of patients, coordination of floor and nursing staff, and floor staff training.

positions.title: Senior CSO
positions.description: Campus security and enforcement, training and leadership of CSO team.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: HVTN 505 UT Southwestern HIV Research Trial
volunteerExperiences.description: Served as a Co-Chair for the UT Southwestern branch of the HVTN 505 HIV Research Vaccine Trial. Although the vaccine trial proved unsuccessful in 2015, I spent years supporting the trial as a community adviser, building relationships with local organizations and community leaders, recruiting study participants, and raising funds for the outreach branch of the organization.

company.name: HVTN 505 UT Southwestern HIV Research Trial
